answer.reason: The instance has an "Images" component (referenceName Gallery, described as "Image grid.") whose Images field is a linked grid of "Gallery Image" items (referenceName GalleryImage). Each GalleryImage item is a single picture tile (ImageAttachment + Caption), which is exactly the kind of "picture tiles" section described — so a new tile with a large product screenshot should be created as a new GalleryImage content item (with the screenshot in its Image field) and added to the existing Gallery component's Images grid.
